sovereign_country.strategic_role: 支持全中文章程、传统华人客群离岸家族信托常驻地

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Private Investment Holding for High-Net-Worth Family Assets

applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: PRC-Samoa Bilateral Investment Treaty (entered into force 1999)
Samoa-New Zealand Investment Promotion and Protection Agreement
Samoa-Australia Trade and Investment Framework Arrangement

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: International Companies Act 1987 (as amended, consolidated through 2018), Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act 2019, Financial Intelligence Unit Act 2019, International Companies Regulations 1987, and the Companies (International) (Evidence of Registration and Other Matters) Rules

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified true copy of passport or national identity card of each Ultimate Beneficial Owner and legal representative
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public of the country of origin; authenticated by the competent ministry if the issuing state is a Hague Apostille member

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified copy of address proof (utility bill or bank statement) for each Ultimate Beneficial Owner
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Issuing utility company or financial institution; notarised by a licensed notary

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank reference and good-standing letter from the Ultimate Beneficial Owner's primary relationship bank
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Licensed financial institution in the country of origin

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Professional reference letter from legal counsel, accountant, or corporate services provider confirming background and source of wealth
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: The professional intermediary rendering the reference

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Structural chart and written UBO declaration listing all natural person owners, trustees, and settlor/protector details for the proposed International Company
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Proposed corporate service provider or Samoan licensed registered agent

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Power of attorney appointing the Samoan registered agent and local secretary, validly executed and notarised
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public of the principal's jurisdiction of residence

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all Ultimate Beneficial Owners, directors, secretaries, agents, and authorised signatories against the United Nations Security Council Consolidated List, Samoa Consolidated Sanctions Lists promulgated under the Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act 2019, the United States Office of Foreign Assets Control sanctions programs, and the Financial Action Task Force blacklist and grey-list jurisdictions. Enhanced due diligence applies where any UBO is a Politically Exposed Person; independent source-of-wealth verification and senior management approval are mandatory. Adverse screening results trigger immediate registry refusal and submission of a Suspicious Transaction Report to the Samoa Financial Intelligence Unit.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Samoa International Companies Registry (SICR) online portal administered by the Samoa International Financial Authority
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The company name must be stated in English or in Roman letters; Chinese-script names are not accepted in the statutory register, but a parallel Chinese trade name may be reserved and used as a business descriptor. The name must include a corporate ending such as 'Limited', 'Ltd', 'Corporation', 'Inc', 'Public Limited Company', or an acceptable abbreviation, and the proposed name must be distinct in the registry so as not to create a likelihood of confusion with an existing company, protected name, or cross-border registered entity.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: If a proposed name is refused, the applicant or licensed registered agent may submit a written appeal to the Registrar of International Companies within 14 calendar days of the refusal notification, together with a fee of USD 500 and a legal memorandum demonstrating distinctiveness, non-user deception, and compliance with the International Companies Act 1987. The Registrar must determine the appeal within 10 working days, and an adverse decision may be further appealed to the Samoan Supreme Court by judicial review.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A fully virtual registered office is not permitted for an International Company. The entity must maintain a physical registered office in Samoa, which is typically the licensed registered agent's address. A virtual office may be employed solely for administrative correspondence and customer relations, provided it is not used as the statutory registered office and does not create an appearance of an unauthorised place of business.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Moderate risk of unannounced on-site inspection; estimated at 12% per annual compliance cycle, increasing to 35% where the Single Family Office deals in high-value global assets, has cross-border trust structures, or is deemed a higher-risk customer by the Samoa Financial Intelligence Unit.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Samoa International Company incorporation registration fee with share capital up to USD 1,000,000
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff under the International Companies Act 1987 and associated fee regulations

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Name reservation and availability check fee (one standard name plus two alternate names)
Registered agent and registered office arrangement for the first calendar year
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Licensed Samoan corporate services provider or registered agent
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for International Company administration

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Pre-incorporation AML/CFT UBO due diligence and PEP/sanctions screening per Ultimate Beneficial Owner
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Samoan registered agent and external compliance reviewer

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarisation, consular legalisation, and document authentication bundle for six original instruments
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Notary public and Samoan diplomatic/consular post or overseas authentication authority
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing official tariff plus courier cost

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Drafting of Memorandum and Articles of Association, constitutional trust overlay, and private family office governance annex
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Samoan licensed legal counsel and tax adviser
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for private client corporate structuring

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Filing of UBO record and maintenance of confidential beneficial ownership register with the registered agent
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff and compliance admin fee

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Bank account facilitation and private banking pre-approval arrangement for Singapore-based or Hong Kong-based private bank
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Private bank and Samoan agent as introducer
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for high-net-worth foreign trust account onboarding

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Contingency for Samoan stamp duty, ministerial clearance, or expedited processing
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Samoa Revenue Authority or International Company Registrar
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Expected statutory tariff plus administrative allocation

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Companies Act 1987 (as amended), ss. 5-9 (incorporation, memorandum and articles), ss. 55-56 (registered office and agent), ss. 79-91 (directors); Income Tax Act 2012 (tax exemption schedule for international companies).
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registrar of International Companies, Companies Registry, Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour (MCIL), Apia, Samoa.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Memorandum and Articles of Association accompanied by the prescribed Application for Incorporation of an International Company lodged under s. 5 of the International Companies Act 1987.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital; shares of no par value are permitted; no escrow, bank deposit or capital verification condition applies. The authorized capital level only determines the registry fee tier.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en:
RESOLVED THAT:
1. The subscriber's subscription of 10,000 ordinary no-par-value shares, as stated in the Memorandum, is approved and the Chairman is authorised to execute the allotment.
2. The registered office at [Agent Address], Apia, Samoa, is adopted as the Company's registered office under the International Companies Act 1987, and the registered agent is retained.
3. The first directors, namely [Director A], [Director B] and [Director C], are appointed to serve until the first annual general meeting.
4. [Corporate Services Provider] is appointed as Company Secretary.
5. The Directors are authorised to file statutory returns, issue share certificates, open private banking and custody accounts, and take all ancillary actions.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of International Companies, Companies Registry, MCIL, Apia
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a name reservation application listing three ranked proposed names. The Registry rejects names that are misleading, identical or confusingly similar to an existing company, or that contain restricted words such as 'bank', 'trust' or 'insurance' without a separate license. Approved names are reserved for 30 calendar days.
required_dossiers: Copy of passport of the incorporator or licensed registered-agent instruction letter
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is refused or objected to, submit a fresh list of alternative names; a written reconsideration request may be filed with the Registrar where the refusal is disputed.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Preparation and Execution of Memorandum and Articles of Association
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed International Company registered agent (execution supervision)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the Memorandum and Articles in English, including the company name, registered office and agent clauses, an investment-holding object clause, and share capital provisions permitting no-par-value shares. At least one subscriber must sign each document; a corporate subscriber signs under seal by authorized officers.
required_dossiers: Signed Memorandum and Articles of Association
Subscriber identity documents (passport and proof of address)
Certified board resolution of any corporate subscriber
Registered office and agent consent letter in Samoa
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registry queries the object clause or share provisions, instruct counsel to amend by supplementary memorandum and refile before the statutory response deadline.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Lodgment of Incorporation Application and Payment of Fees
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of International Companies, Companies Registry, MCIL, Apia
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Lodge the signed Memorandum and Articles together with the Application for Incorporation and remit the USD 200 government registration fee (higher fee applies for larger authorized capital). The Registry will issue a receipt and review the file for formal compliance.
required_dossiers: Signed Memorandum and Articles of Association
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the application is queried for deficient fees or forms, correct the defect and refile within 14 days; otherwise the application is deemed abandoned and fees are forfeited.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Issuance of Certificate of Incorporation and Establishment of Statutory Registers
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of International Companies, Companies Registry, MCIL, Apia
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon final approval the Registrar enters the company in the International Companies Register and issues the Certificate of Incorporation. The company must maintain at its registered office the register of members, register of directors and secretary, register of charges and minute book.
required_dossiers: Initial share certificates and common seal (if adopted)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Certificate contains a clerical error, apply to the Registrar for rectification under the correction procedure in the International Companies Act 1987.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Tax Exemption Confirmation and AML Readiness for Private Banking and Custody Onboarding
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Ministry of Revenue, Samoa; licensed registered agent (AML compliance)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Register the International Company with the Ministry of Revenue and obtain written confirmation of the income tax exemption applicable to foreign-source income of exempt international companies. Prepare the customer due diligence file (beneficial owner, source of funds, and family-office governance) to satisfy the medium-risk enhanced due diligence standard of Samoan and correspondent private banks and securities custodians.
required_dossiers: Board resolution designating the AML compliance contact
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the exemption confirmation is delayed, issue a written follow-up to the Commissioner of Revenue and, where necessary, escalate jointly through the licensed registered agent.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Not applicable — no industrial operating license is required for a single-family office; general premises control is exercised by the Planning and Urban Management Agency (PUMA), Ministry of Natural Resources and Environment (MNRE), Samoa.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Not applicable — no operating or manufacturing permit required; only an office occupancy/building permit for physical premises if leased in Samoa.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Planning and Urban Management Agency (PUMA), Ministry of Natural Resources and Environment (MNRE), Samoa
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt / Register-Only — pure administrative private-investment holding does not trigger a full EIA Report under the Planning and Urban Management Act 2004.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Not applicable to investment-holding activities; a leased office must comply with municipal waste collection rules, negligible VOC/emission thresholds, and the effluent standards set under Samoan environmental regulations if any sanitary discharge occurs.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire Safety Certificate from the Samoa Fire and Emergency Services Authority (FESA) for any occupied office; structural load clearance by the building authority (PUMA) for the leased premises; and occupational health and safety workplace clearance administered by the Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour (MCIL).

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Samoa Revenue Authority (SRA), Ministry of Revenue; official online portal: https://www.sra.gov.ws
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign entity or an International Company must apply for a Samoa Taxpayer Identification Number (TIN) using the corporate TIN registration form, accompanied by the certificate of incorporation, memorandum and articles of association, registered office and registered agent details, and, for an International Company, evidence of its exempt status under the International Companies Act. The SRA issues the TIN without requiring a tax residence approval for offshore entities whose income is statutorily exempt.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box or hybrid-mismatch entity classification election is available under Samoa law. The International Company is automatically a tax-exempt offshore entity under the International Companies Act. Samoa's general anti-avoidance rules may disregard arrangements designed to exploit hybrid mismatch effects.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: VAGST (Value Added Goods and Services Tax)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: WST 100,000 per annum of taxable supplies, calculated on the aggregate turnover threshold as set under the VAGST Act
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No mandatory real-time e-invoicing, fiscal clearance, API clearance, or digital stamping regime is currently in force. Registered persons are required to issue a valid VAGST invoice in paper or electronic form and to retain all sales, purchase, and export records for SRA audit.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Goods exported from Samoa qualify for a 0% VAGST rate where the supplier establishes that the goods have physically left Samoa pursuant to a contract of sale, lease, or hire-purchase with a person who is outside Samoa at the time of supply. Certain services provided to a non-resident and enjoyed outside Samoa may be zero-rated. An International Company carrying on offshore business for non-residents is exempt from VAGST and income tax under the International Companies Act, thereby falling outside the domestic taxable supply regime.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Samoa Customs export declaration (approved and stamped)
Bill of lading or airway bill
Inward remittance certificate or bank transfer evidence
Export contract and foreign buyer documentation
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Erroneous or fraudulent zero-rating claims are subject to SRA audit scrutiny, retrospective clawback of any improperly allowed input tax credits, and payment of the full amount of unded VAGST. Penalties may include a civil penalty of up to 100% of the tax evaded, late payment interest and penalties, and, for deliberate falsification of export documentation, criminal fines and imprisonment under the VAGST Act and the Tax Administration Act.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Central Bank of Samoa (CBS) — Exchange Control Division, pursuant to the Exchange Control Act 1976 and delegated powers from the Minister of Finance
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Samoa's currency (Samoan Tālā, WST) is not freely convertible. Resident current-account transactions require documentary support through an authorized dealer; capital-account movements require CBS approval. An International Company (IC) registered under the International Companies Act 1987 is treated as non-resident for exchange control purposes: it may hold and operate foreign-currency accounts, switch currencies freely offshore, and remit profits/dividends without CBS approval. Onshore conversion to WST is only available via licensed commercial banks and may be limited by market liquidity. Profit remittance hurdles are effectively absent for ICs where all funds remain in foreign currency; dividends and distributions transmit cleanly via SWIFT MT103.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: General Samoa surrender rule for resident exporters: export proceeds must be repatriated through a licensed bank within 30 days of receipt, and 100% of the foreign exchange must be sold to the authorized dealer unless a standing foreign-currency account exemption has been issued. International Companies are statutorily outside this regime—there is no mandatory conversion ratio or surrender timeline for IC export receipts. The SFO should direct all counterparties to remit directly to the IC's foreign-currency account at an authorized dealer in Samoa or abroad, clearly tagged as 'non-resident IC proceeds'.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Account / Multi-Currency USD and EUR

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility Rating: Low-to-Medium. Samoa has no domestic EMI licensing or regulatory sandbox. A licensed foreign EMI (e.g., FCA-, MAS-, or EEA-authorised) may accept the IC for bank-to-bank transfer services if its KYC accepts offshore companies using nominee directors and family trusts. However, Samoan licensed banks tend to de-risk transfers originating from EMIs, and the Central Bank of Samoa does not extend any equivalence or passporting recognition. The SFO should restrict EMI usage to minor operational amounts and maintain a tier-1 commercial bank as the core clearing and custody hub.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Under the AML/CFT Act 2018 and CBS Anti-Money Laundering Directives, licensed Samoan commercial banks must verify the identity of every director, shareholder, and ultimate beneficial owner at account opening. In practice, banks require either (i) an in-person interview of at least one director and one UBO at the bank's Apia branch, or (ii) a certified apostilled attestation by a licensed Samoan corporate service provider, supplemented by a real-time video call. Fully remote account opening without a local licensed agent and a physical meeting is generally rejected. Therefore, the SFO must appoint an authorized local representative and be prepared to travel the family principal or director to Samoa.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: UBO concealed behind a discretionary family trust or foundation nominee.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Trust deed, declaration of trust, beneficiary schedule or class description, certified passport copies of settlor, protector and UBO, professional reference from the family's external legal counsel, sworn source-of-wealth statement covering accumulated assets.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Non-face-to-face onboarding with electronic signatures and no physical office presence.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Independent due diligence report from a recognised compliance firm, video-recorded director consent, electronic notarisation by a Samoan notary, IC registry certificate and certificate of incumbency.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Transactions originating from crypto asset disposals or private holding companies in high-risk jurisdictions.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Complete chain-of-funds ledger from crypto exchange with travel-rule compliance records, liquidation summary of assets, independently audited financial statements for the previous year, exchange KYC records and power-of-attorney confirmation.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: PEP status of the family principal or an appointed director.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: PEP declaration and relationship explanation, proof of legitimate origin of wealth (tax returns, sale contracts, payroll records), business reference letters from a regulated financial adviser, and an independent third-party sanctions/PEP screening report.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Inbound capital injections must be executed by SWIFT MT103 wire transfer from the origin bank to the IC's designated USD/EUR account at a tier-1 Samoan commercial bank or applicable offshore bank. Recommended SWIFT field usage: Beneficiary 'WS IC Single Family Office'; Remittance Information 'Capital Contribution — Non-Resident International Company'; Purpose Code 'CAPI' (capital contribution) or 'GRANT' where the bank's code set requires. Verification package must include: board resolution authorising the injection, share subscription agreement or loan facility letter, IC incumbency certificate, matching source-of-funds statement, and an explanatory note confirming that no Samoan exchange control approval is required because the IC is non-resident. Banks may impose an internal compliance hold on first-time inbound remittances.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Permitted clearing rails for outbound disbursements are: (a) SWIFT MT103 for cash transactions, using the IC's operational account for fee payments, investment purchases, and distributions; (b) Commercial Documentary Letter of Credit under UCP600 for goods or tangible instruments requiring title documentation, issued by the Samoan bank through its correspondent network; (c) SWIFT MT300 for FX spot transactions where a hedge is executed. All outbound messages should include the beneficiary's full name, city, country, a clear payment description, and purpose code. Samoan banks will automatically screen against OFAC, UN, and EU sanctions lists and may pause same-day execution if the text is ambiguous.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Outright FX forwards (non-deliverable for WST, deliverable for major currency pairs)
Non-deliverable forward (NDF) contracts on Samoan Tālā (WST) executed offshore

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Licence Renewal and Annual Return of an International Company
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of International Companies, Samoa International Financial Services Authority (SIFSA)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before the anniversary date of incorporation each year; renewal period opens 30 days prior and closes on the due date
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: A late renewal penalty of USD 60 per month or part thereof is imposed on arrears; companies remaining in default beyond 6 months after the anniversary date are liable to administrative strike-off from the Register of International Companies, with restoration requiring a formal reinstatement application and payment of all outstanding fees, penalties, and restoration costs

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: International Companies (Economic Substance) Enforcement Unit, Samoa International Financial Services Authority (SIFSA)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 12 months after the end of the company's financial year; financial year alignment is established in the first declaration
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to submit the annual economic substance declaration exposes the International Company to penalty notices of up to USD 2,000 per contravention, ongoing daily fines for continued non-compliance, risk of information exchange notifications to foreign tax authorities, and eventual strike-off or revocation of the international company licence

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Confirmation of Beneficial Ownership Register Details
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of International Companies, Samoa International Financial Services Authority (SIFSA)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Submitted concurrently with the annual licence renewal on the anniversary date of incorporation; any change in beneficial ownership must be notified within 14 days of the change
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Non-compliant International Companies are liable to fines up to USD 2,000 and directors or agents may face personal fines; continued breach permits the Registrar to suspend voting rights or strike off the company

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Registered Agent and Registered Office Continuation Certificate
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registered Agent of the International Company acting as intermediary to the Registrar of International Companies, SIFSA
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually by the anniversary date of incorporation; agent confirms the registered office address, director details, and register location in the renewal filing
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to maintain a licensed registered agent and registered office in Samoa is a continuing statutory contravention; the Registrar may issue a default notice and, on expiry, strike off the company from the register, after which the entity loses legal capacity to operate and all assets vest in the Official Receiver pending restoration

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: An International Company is exempt from the statutory audit requirement if its authorized share capital does not exceed USD 1,000,000 and it has no more than 20 shareholders; a mandatory audit is triggered where authorized share capital exceeds USD 1,000,000, where the company holds a banking, trust, or insurance licence, or where the company elects not to claim exempt status; the single-family office holding vehicle in this engagement is presumed exempt under the USD 1,000,000 authorized capital threshold
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: International Companies are not required to file financial statements with the Registrar; exempt companies may maintain internal accounting records in accordance with a foreign GAAP chosen by the directors; non-exempt International Companies preparing audited statements must apply International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS); all entities must maintain accounting records sufficient to accurately explain transactions and to enable preparation of true and fair financial statements

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Every International Company must maintain a Beneficial Ownership Register at its registered office in Samoa identifying individuals who directly or indirectly hold more than 25% of shares, voting rights, or control; an annual confirmation of the register is filed with the Registrar as part of the annual renewal cycle on each incorporation anniversary; any transfer of shares or change of beneficial ownership interest must be recorded in the register and notified to the Registrar within 14 days of the change, regardless of the annual confirmation cycle

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 1,750 - USD 4,500 per annum for a voluntary or non-exempt audit engagement; exempt single-family office International Companies typically incur no mandatory audit fee

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: 0% effective rate for a Samoa International Company (IC). Under the International Companies Act 1987 (as amended), an IC is statutorily exempt from all Samoa income tax, withholding taxes, and stamp duty on profits derived from outside Samoa, in exchange for the prescribed annual government fee. The standard resident company rate of 25% is displaced by this exemption for offshore-source income.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: International Company Annual Declaration and Government Fee Renewal — lodged with the Registrar of International Companies, Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour (MCIL), Samoa Companies Office. No income tax return is filed with the Samoa Inland Revenue Department (IRD) for a tax-exempt IC.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Return and annual government fee must be submitted on or before the anniversary of the date of incorporation each year.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Registered company name, registration number, and date of incorporation.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Insert the exact IC registration number and name as recorded in the Samoa International Companies Register.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Name and address of the licensed registered agent and the registered office in Samoa.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Confirm the registered agent is a licensed Samoa corporate services provider; the registered office must remain in Samoa.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Particulars of directors, shareholders, and ultimate beneficial owners.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Provide full legal names, residential addresses, nationality, and passport copies for non-resident owners; maintain beneficial ownership register per Samoa AML/CFT obligations.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Statement of commercial purpose using ISIC code classification.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter 'Private investment holding for high-net-worth family assets — ISIC 6430 / Single Family Office (SFO)'.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Declaration that the IC has not carried on business in Samoa with Samoan residents and that all revenue is derived from outside Samoa.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Tick the exemption declaration; describe in a note the offshore custody and private-banking securities assets held for the family.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Affirmation that no Samoan land, Samoan service contracts, or Samoan trading activities were undertaken.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Ensure the declaration is truthful; any false statement may trigger mandatory exchange of information and loss of exemption.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Computation of the annual government fee and any late penalty.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Remit via approved banking channel before the anniversary date; retain proof of payment as evidence of active registry status.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late submission attracts a prescribed late penalty applied by the Registrar; continued non-payment of the annual government fee results in strike-off from the International Companies Register after statutory notice. Restoration is judicial and requires full settlement of arrears, penalties, and legal costs.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: IRD Company Income Tax Return (Form CT-1) via Samoa Inland Revenue Department — applicable only in the exceptional case where an IC triggers resident status or derives Samoa-source taxable income; a fully exempt IC files no CT-1.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Due within the statutory period after the company's balance date as prescribed in the Income Tax Act 2015; commonly aligned with the last day of the fourth month following fiscal year-end.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: IRD taxpayer number and entity particulars.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Obtain a Samoa TIN only if a residual Samoan tax exposure exists; otherwise no registration is required.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Computation of assessable income, deductions, and taxable income.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Declare only Samoan-source income in this frame; offshore IC income is excluded by statute and must not be included.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late lodgment: fixed penalty plus daily interest on any unpaid assessed tax; deliberate understatement or non-declaration attracts evasion penalties up to 100% of the shortfall plus imprisonment on conviction.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 15% statutory non-resident dividend withholding tax under the Income Tax Act 2015; reduced to an effective 0% for dividends paid by an exempt International Company because the underlying profits and distributions are statutorily tax-exempt.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Samoa maintains no comprehensive double tax agreement network; only tax information exchange agreements (TIEAs) are in force with selected jurisdictions. An exempt IC is wholly outside the dividend withholding tax net and therefore does not require treaty relief or a tax residency certificate (TRC). In the rare event a resident-company dividend is assessable, the protocol would require the shareholder's certificate of residence, a valid TIN, and an IRD ruling; however, no such proceeding applies to IC distributions.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory final withholding on interest and royalties paid to non-residents is 15% under the Income Tax Act 2015; the effective rate for an exempt International Company is 0% on account of the IC Act exemption from all Samoan taxation, including interest and royalty flows from offshore assets or onward lending.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: No statutory Local File or Master File threshold is codified in Samoa domestic law. The Income Tax Act 2015 imports an arm's length standard for associated-party dealings, but the IRD has not published monetary documentation thresholds. A tax-exempt IC conducting private investment holding via custody and private banking has no transfer pricing documentation obligation.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Applicability of Economic Substance Regulations (ESR): Samoa's international company legislation has been aligned with OECD/EU substance standards. A Single Family Office engaged in pure passive holding of shares and securities must demonstrate adequate board management, physical registered office, and core income-generating activities in Samoa, or rely on delegation to a licensed Samoa corporate services provider. Nominee-only substance is a fatal deficiency and exposes the IC to penalty action and information exchange.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Tax Evasion / Fraudulent Misdeclaration of Residency
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Exercising management and control of the IC from Samoa through Samoan-resident directors, holding decision-making board meetings in Apia, or deriving undisclosed investment-management services connected with Samoa while continuing to claim the offshore exemption in Box 5 of the annual declaration.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Reclassification of the IC as a Samoa resident company; assessment of corporate income tax at 25% on worldwide profits; statutory interest on underpaid tax; evasion penalties of up to 100% of the tax shortfall; criminal prosecution on indictment with substantial fines.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who sign false declarations are personally liable for penalties and tax arrears; the courts may pierce the corporate veil in fraud; directors may face travel bans, asset restraint orders, and imprisonment for fraud or perjury.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Company / Failure of Economic Substance
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Maintaining only a registered agent and no real presence, no local decision-making records, no minutes of board meetings, and no documentation of the family office's investment oversight, custody instructions, or securities-holding rationale.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Registrar power to strike off the IC; administrative monetary penalties under the economic substance regime; escalation of the file to the Samoa competent authority for spontaneous exchange of information with foreign tax authorities; revocation of the tax exemption.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors may be made personally accountable for penalty amounts; disqualification from acting as director for a defined statutory period; personal liability for restoration costs if the entity is struck off and later reinstated.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: AML/CFT Breach and Concealment of Beneficial Ownership
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Routing obscure third-party or related-party funds through Samoa private-banking wire rails and securities custody accounts with no economic rationale; failing to update the beneficial ownership register; using bearer arrangements or layered nominee structures to evade reporting.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Prosecution under Samoa's AML/CFT legislation; confiscation of proceeds; fines against the body corporate and individuals; administrative enforcement by the Samoa Financial Intelligence Unit and Registrar; removal of the licensed agent's approval.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors face criminal liability and imprisonment on conviction, civil confiscation of assets, disqualification from financial-sector directorships, and travel restrictions while investigations are pending.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Declaring a dividend immediately after tax-exempt gains, receiving the funds in a private banking account, and simultaneously returning the same funds to the IC as a loan or subscription in a structured round-trip designed to shelter foreign CFC tax exposure.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Samoa's general anti-avoidance rule may disregard the scheme to the extent it creates Samoan-source taint; the annual declaration will be rejected if it misrepresents activity; the case may be disclosed to treaty partners under the tax information exchange framework.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who architect or authorize the circular flow may be liable in the foreign parent jurisdiction for foreign tax penalties; within Samoa they risk personal sanction for filing false or misleading information and court-ordered restitution of redirected amounts.
